verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.api.gusto.com that uses OAuth2 and lets users scope which data categories an agent can reach, with documented setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini CLI. It also offers a separate Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server that connects AI editors and Claude Desktop to the Embedded Payroll API and docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP servers work as documented.
